purpose: Separate human review material; no executable tests, runner, measured scores or statistical quality validation
review_protocol: Provide only governing instructions, task_input and supplied_evidence to a future evaluated caller. Keep expected_facts, forbidden_claims and criteria with the reviewer. Review each fact, citation, abstention and language meaning independently; record any actual future outcome separately.
